title: caltha emodorum
intro: Caltha emodorum, commonly known as the yellow marsh marigold, is a perennial aquatic plant in the family Ranunculaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in Chinese medicine to treat various health conditions due to its numerous health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antiviral properties. The therapeutic actions of Caltha emodorum include its ability to clear heat, reduce fever, and relieve pain, as well as its use in treating respiratory issues such as bronchitis and cough. The bioactive constituents of Caltha emodorum include alkaloids, glycosides, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
